post.title: Impulse buys cost about $3,000 a year. Try the 30-day rule
post.ig:
You lose about $3,000 a year to impulse buys.

Slickdeals' 2025 survey: about $254 a month on unplanned purchases, roughly 10 buys a month.
The 30-day rule: write it down, wait 30 days, then decide.
The FTC's Cooling-Off Rule gives you 3 business days to cancel certain in-person sales ($25+ at home, $130+ at temporary locations).

Sources: Slickdeals surveys (2020-2025), FTC.
News and education, not financial advice.
